**Modular curves, invariant theory and E 8**

*Lei Yang*

39 pp, 13 sections.

**Abstract.** The E8 root lattice can be constructed from the modular curve X(13) by the invariant theory for the simple group PSL(2, 13). This gives a diﬀerent construction of the E8 root lattice. It also gives an explicit construction of the modular curve X(13).
